name: com.money2route/policy-fund
title: Money2Route(자금줄) 소상공인 정책자금
description: Korean small business policy loans: eligibility check with notice pages, search, details, glossary

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): check a Korean small business against 293 government policy loans. Returns per fund ok (eligible for the given inputs) / check (needs confirmation) / no, with reasons and the page of the official notice, plus not_checked (common restrictions not evaluated) and apply_open (intake status). ok is not a loan approval. All inputs are optional: omitted inputs yield 'check', never a rejection, so partial information (e.g. only industry and region) is enough. 사업자 조건으로 정책자금마다 자격을 공고 쪽수 근거와 함께 판정.

industry.description: 업종 — 일상어(예: 카페, 미용실) 또는 KSIC 11차 5자리 코드·대분류 글자(A~U)

received_5y.description: 최근 5년 받은 소상공인 정책자금 횟수(특별경영안정자금 제외 · 4 = 4회 이상)

owner_age.description: 대표 만 나이 — 39세 이하면 청년 대표 자격(youth)으로 봄

good_repay.description: 시설자금이거나 직접대출 성실상환(3회 제한 1회 추가 예외)

quals.description: 해당하는 자격(없으면 빈 배열 · 안 넣으면 확인 필요). disaster=재해 확인서, youth=청년 대표, youthhire=청년 고용, women=여성기업, disabled=장애인기업, restart=재창업, debtadj=채무조정 성실상환, highrate=고금리 대출, growth=성장 실적, invest=투자 유치, program=육성사업 선정

tools.name: search_funds
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): search Korean small business policy loans by Korean keywords (e.g. 청년, 재창업), province and purpose. Returns rate, limit in KRW, term, intake and source URL. 낱말·지역·용도로 정책자금 찾기.

tools.name: get_fund
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): one fund's rate, term, limit and lending channel per track, eligibility clauses with notice pages, intake status and FAQ. id comes from search_funds or check_eligibility. 자금 하나의 상세.

tools.name: find_industry_code
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): map an everyday Korean business word (e.g. 치킨, 미용실) to Korean Standard Industrial Classification (KSIC 11th) 5-digit codes for check_eligibility. 업종 일상어 → 표준산업분류 코드.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): plain-Korean explanation of policy loan terms such as 거치기간 (grace period) or 기준금리 (base rate). 정책자금 낱말 풀이.
